output.title: New certificate timestamp metrics reach the enabled ServiceMonitor scrape
output.content: v1.18.0 adds certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds. The environment sets prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled and has cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests, so these series will plausibly be scraped. Inspect whether dashboards or alerts should use them and whether the added series matter for your monitoring.
